title: Keep apexyard.ai in sync with every framework release
intent: The site never claims a stale framework state. Every version, count, and list on apexyard.ai matches one declared apexyard release tag. A release is not done until the site declares it.

outcomes.title: Site content matches the framework release the site declares, and that release is the latest.
outcomes.intent: Version, primitive counts, skill list, agent manifests, and OG cards agree with the declared tag. The declared tag is the newest published release.

outcomes.title: A release sync is a declared, verified step.
outcomes.intent: One tracked file declares the tag. CI fails any pull request whose pages disagree with it. The site stays hand-authored and verified, not generated.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Every page and manifest names the framework version that the declared tag names, in both the v-prefixed and bare forms.
The primitive counts on every page and manifest equal the counts derived from the declared tag.
skill.md lists every skill shipped at the declared tag and no retired skill.
The OG card images show the primitive counts derived from the declared tag.
The declared tag is the newest published apexyard release.
One tracked file declares the framework tag the site describes, and nothing else states the tag as a source.
Every pull request fails CI when any page or manifest disagrees with the declared tag.
The README sync section names the declared-tag file and lists the release-line prose as the only manual step.
No open issue in the site tracker duplicates work this Plan covers.
